title: Magic: The Gathering 1997 Calendar: 365 Days in Dominia

paragraphs.text: The Magic: The Gathering 1997 calendar 365 Days in Dominia was a page-a-day calendar published by Workman Publishing in Fall 1996.
Scott Hungerford was involved as continuity editor for Wizards of the Coast , while Michael G. Ryan functioned as the main editor.

Each day provided a full-color piece of Magic art , complete with strategy tips, card backgrounds, snippets about Dominia (the old name for the Multiverse ), comments from artists , and Magic trivia. It was an important early storyline source .
